text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan, let's race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Sure thing, bring it on! Even 
though I don't know what kind of match it 
is!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's decided to enjoy Halloween this 
year at full throttle right from the very 
start!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So, let's see who can get the most candy 
this Halloween. Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, in that case, challenge accepted~! 
I'm not gonna lose, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san! Trick or treat! Give me some 
sweets or I'll play a trick on you!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, treat, treat. I'll give you 
sweets, so just playtest this for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What is it~?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's a puzzle game program I'm puttin' 
together. I'm makin' the Halloween 
visitors debug it for me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, do this here, and then do that over 
here~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haaah? What kind of solution is that? 
There's no damn logic to it at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch. It's a match, huh. Must've 
under-adjusted. Take it."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trick or treat, Doto-chan, give me sweets 
or... Huh? Wait, eeeh? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hau~. I prepared so many treats to liven 
up Halloween, but then I tripped and 
fell...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it really was presumptuous of me 
to think I could liven up a festival...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. It just shows how much 
Doto-chan is giving her all for Halloween!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's decided to enjoy this year with the 
throttle wide open from the start, too~. 
So together now~, Trick or Treat~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, thank you so much~! Please take 
lots and lots of sweets with you~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Hello everyone from the Ritto and 
Miho dorms~! Are you enjoying the 
Halloween event~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Found Creek-san~! Your Halloween costume 
looks so mature, I'm so jealous~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~. Your kitty outfit looks so lovely 
and cute too, Maya-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ If you don't give me treats, I'll 
turn into a mischievous kitty, meow!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~, that simply won't do~. I'll 
have to give you lots and lo~ts of 
sweets~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Mayano. It's time to weigh in and 
see who gathered more!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, be the referee, okay? Maya's 
super confident!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm. In terms of numbers received, I 
win, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you add it all up, Maya wins in total 
weight, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can't accept that at all~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right! In that case, let's go for one more 
match—

I frantically stop the two of them. 
There's already an immense pile of sweets 
on the table as it is.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you can finish all this?
Are you sure you can finish all this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I ran a ton for our match, so of 
course I'm starving!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Besides, sweet treats are 
the source of all my energy! Something 
like this is a piece of cake!

With that, the two began happily snacking 
together, and by the time the sun set, 
they had devoured it all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I hadn't thought that far. What 
should we do?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, in that case, in that case, why 
don't we invite all our friends and share?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Time for an impromptu 
Halloween sweets party!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right, finishing all of this 
might be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan... Please! Help me finish 
eating this~~.

I ate with her and advised her to save the 
leftovers to eat little by little across 
different days.
